mapper.insert: insert into cm_contact_leads ( id, source, inquiry_type, name, contact_channel, contact_value, message, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{source}, #{inquiryType}, #{name}, #{contactChannel}, #{contactValue}, #{message}, 'new', current_timestamp, current_timestamp )
mapper.select: select l.id, l.source, l.inquiry_type as inquiryType, l.name, l.contact_channel as contactChannel, l.contact_value as contactValue, l.message, l.status, l.handler_sys_user_id as handlerSysUserId, l.handler_note as handlerNote, l.handled_at as handledAt, l.created_at as createdAt, l.updated_at as updatedAt, su.user_name as handlerUserName, su.nick_name as handlerNickName from cm_contact_leads l left join sys_user su on su.user_id = l.handler_sys_user_id where l.id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update cm_contact_leads set status = #{status}, handler_sys_user_id = #{handlerSysUserId}, handler_note = #{handlerNote}, handled_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
